page: Amazon Web Services i7i.metal-24xl is a bare-metal storage-optimized server designed for I/O-intensive workloads requiring direct access to underlying x86_64 hardware. Driven by dual-socket Intel Xeon 8559C processors operating at 3.2 GHz, it provides 48 physical cores and 96 dedicated vCPUs with hyper-threading enabled. Compute capacity is backed by a 320 MB L3 cache and hardware support for Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) and AVX-512 vector instructions. System memory comprises 768 GB of high-speed DDR5 RAM clocked at 6 GHz, maintaining an 8 GB per vCPU allocation.

Integrated local storage is a primary differentiator of the i7i.metal-24xl, offering 22,500 GB of high-throughput local NVMe SSD capacity directly attached to the host. Networking interfaces deliver a baseline throughput of 56 Gbps, preventing bandwidth bottlenecks during cluster synchronization and distributed data ingestion. The platform operates without virtualization overhead and contains no discrete graphics accelerators.

Benchmark results demonstrate strong parallel processing capabilities, evidenced by a multi-core Geekbench score of 22,370 and a PassMark CPU score of 95,121.66. Memory bandwidth testing shows high-throughput execution with 289.55 GB/s uncached large-block reads and 6,647.86 GB/s cached read throughput. Synthetic application tests record 122.39 million Redis SET operations per second and 136.82 GB/s in static web serving throughput. CPU-based small and medium model LLM prompt processing achieves strong token generation rates utilizing AMX tile acceleration.

Given its combination of high-density NVMe storage, broad memory channels, and 96 dedicated execution threads, the i7i.metal-24xl delivers balanced hardware density for demanding applications without the virtualization layer. It is technically suited for large distributed NoSQL databases, transactional relational database management systems (RDBMS), real-time log analytics engines, in-memory caching tiers, and localized high-performance data processing pipelines.
description: Amazon Web Services i7i.metal-24xl is a bare-metal storage-optimized server engineered for data-intensive enterprise workloads. Powered by Intel Xeon 8559C processors running at 3.2 GHz, the system delivers 48 physical cores, 96 dedicated vCPUs, and 768 GB of high-speed 6 GHz DDR5 memory. Storage capabilities are anchored by 22,500 GB of integrated local NVMe SSD storage paired with a 56 Gbps baseline network interface. Hardware features include Intel AMX and AVX-512 instructions, supporting high-throughput matrix computation. Benchmarks confirm top-tier performance across parallel processing metrics, including a PassMark CPU score of 95,121.66, 122.39 million Redis SET operations per second, and 289.55 GB/s uncached memory read bandwidth. Without hypervisor overhead or bundled GPUs, the server provides direct hardware control and significant I/O capacity, making it appropriate for large-scale transactional databases, distributed NoSQL datastores, Elasticsearch clusters, and high-volume real-time analytics pipelines.
